🚀 anti-slop | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the quality and originality of AI-generated code, UI, and copy by filtering out common AI-generated 'slop'.
✨ Key Features: • Filters generic AI-generated UI designs • Filters filler AI-generated copy • Filters AI-shaped code • Acts as a filter, not a style guide • Complements design direction (e.g., DESIGN.md)
📖 Summary: Anti Slop provides a set of rules designed to filter out generic, uninspired content generated by AI coding agents. It acts as a pre-processing layer to ensure that AI-generated UI, copy, and code are not only functional but also avoid common AI pitfalls like filler text, fake data, and overly generic design elements. The goal is to produce cleaner, more directed, and less 'slop-filled' output from AI coding tools.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 clearcam | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To add intelligent features like object detection, real-time alerts, and searchable recordings to existing or new security camera systems.
✨ Key Features: • Object detection and tracking • Mobile notifications (customizable endpoints) • AI Notification Summaries with Qwen3 VL • Self-hosted NVR solution • Search functionality for recorded events
📖 Summary: Clearcam enhances any security camera by adding object detection, tracking, mobile notifications, and search capabilities. It processes RTSP streams to identify specific events, provides AI-powered summaries of notifications, and offers a self-hosted NVR solution with a companion iOS app.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ reactjs-interview-questions | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Interview preparation for ReactJS developers.
✨ Key Features: • Extensive list of ReactJS interview questions • Answers provided for each question • Covers core React concepts • Includes related technologies like React Router and Redux • Aims to assist in interview preparation
📖 Summary: This repository serves as a comprehensive collection of ReactJS interview questions and answers, designed to aid developers in their preparation for technical interviews. It covers core React concepts, common interview scenarios, and related technologies.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 revanced-manager | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an easy-to-use Android application for patching other Android applications with ReVanced modifications.
✨ Key Features: • Download apps automatically • Select and apply patches to Android apps • Manage patches, apps, signing, themes, and settings
📖 Summary: ReVanced Manager is an Android application designed to patch existing Android applications with modifications provided by the ReVanced project. It simplifies the process of downloading target apps, applying custom patches, and managing these modifications.
